method: Schedule-derived UTC-offset differences (CRS local HHMM and CRSElapsedTime), anchored to Atlanta via IANA America/New_York; consecutive reported flights ordered by actual departure UTC; previous leg must arrive >=60 minutes before target scheduled departure.
dst_transition_boundary: Flights whose scheduled origin and destination local timestamps fall on different EST/EDT regimes are excluded from the first-pass offset graph; this targets the 2025-03-09 US DST transition.
limitations: BTS local-time fields do not directly provide UTC timestamps; inferred airport offsets depend on scheduled elapsed-time consistency and a known Atlanta anchor.
Non-reporting, ferry, maintenance, or otherwise omitted legs may interrupt observed BTS tail sequences.
The Jan 1 boundary censors any previous leg in Dec 2024; link estimates are within the supplied Q1 window.
The 60-minute cutoff is a prespecified analytical choice for this audit, not a claim about airline decision practice.
